g.title: LS
g.text: DIR high = A to B; unused A6-A8 to GND

g.title: SW
g.text: OFF = Orin throttle and steer cut in hardware

g.title: XIAO
g.text: Onboard RGB LED on GPIO22 (enable GPIO23) shows the mode.
D2, D11, D13-D18 spare. D11 (GPIO21, UART1 RX) reserved for a serial receiver.
D8 internal pull-up, low = switch ON.

g.title: VESC
g.text: App = UART; timeout 50 ms, brake current above 0 A
